title: Validity of the generated episode loss sequence
statement: Fix a number of experts $N \ge 1$ and a horizon $T$, and let a learner policy play against an adaptive adversary over $N$ experts. Then the episode loss sequence they generate over the first $T$ rounds is valid: for every round $t < T$ and every expert $i$, the realized loss satisfies $0 \le \ell_t(i) \le 1$.
hypotheses_covered: a learner policy over N experts
an adaptive adversary over N experts
replaced:
For any learner policy and adaptive adversary, the generated loss sequence
$\texttt{episodeLossSeq}\ T\ \mathrm{learner}\ \mathrm{adversary}$ is valid,
meaning every entry lies in $[0, 1]$.  Validity is inherited directly from the
adversary's range condition.
